name: Alison M
text:
This is my favorite hotel in all the world.  Probably because it's in Hawaii and probably because of the amazing location right beside the beach, but either way.  There you have it.

From the friendly and affectionate greeting upon arrival with a cool drink, cool towel and a beautiful floral lei, to the room that opened to the ocean and pool area, to the days spent lounging and enjoying sunshine and sea turtles, there is nothing not to love.

The golf course is interesting and has black lava rock areas that give it a neat visual appeal - there is a walking trail to one of the beach clubs where you can surf and check out snorkel gear.

I fed the large sting ray inside the adventure pond with a bunch of kids for my birthday and enjoyed all the pools - there are several.

Food here is excellent - with poke, nightly specials, sushi, and wonderful desserts served at the main restaurant just steps from the ocean.  I loved their morning smoothies and bowls.

There is a trading post on site for bug spray, snacks, cookies, sunscreen and other sundries should you need them.  That place also has breakfast wraps, acai bowls and more if you don't want to eat every day at the main hotel restaurant.

I had a spa treatment for my birthday here in the traditional Hawaiian massage technique outside listening to the waves by a friendly and engaging lady who gave me tons of advice for where to go when we went on a later coffee tour.

It is set back a bit but with a rental car you can go one way to black sand beaches, exploration and the Kings and Queens shops if you want to purchase some fancy art or jewelry for yourself.  The gift shop on site is also well stocked with plenty of pretty items.

The other direction will take you into town for lunch.

I like that there is no parking fee if you self park and it's completely free.

resp.text:
Aloha Alison,

Mahalo for giving us such an amazing review! We very much appreciate you taking the time to share your experience, and we hope to see you again soon in paradise!

name: Khương Nguyễn Duy
text:
(Translated by Google) Located along the Kona-Kohala coast of Hawaii Island, the Four Seasons Resort Hualalai has the swimming area, 5 dining options and views of the sea. Jack Nicklaus golfers Hualalai Golf is on site. Rooms are equipped with a flat-screen TV.

The modern rooms of the Four Seasons Resort Hualalai at Historic relics Ka'upelehu décor inspired by Hawaii with views of the site or the Pacific resort. Free toiletries and a work desk are also provided.

Guests may enjoy the saltwater pool and areas just for adults as well as full service spa and fitness room measuring 1,393 m². White sand beach of the Four Seasons Resort Haulalai particular have helped calm waters to swim easily.

The hotel has 3 restaurants and 2 lounges. The Beach Tree restaurant serves Mediterranean and Italian cuisine. Guests can enjoy the food and atmosphere of a salon at Hualalai Grille steak, located above the 18 hole golf course.

Resort is a 30-minute drive from Hapuna Beach. Akaka Falls State Park and Hawaii National Volcanic Park are both a 2-hour drive away.

This property is one of the best rated locations in Kaupulehu! Guests like this place more than other places in the area.

(Original)
Nằm dọc theo bờ biển Kona-Kohala của Đảo Hawaii, Four Seasons Resort Hualalai có các khu vực bơi lội, 5 lựa chọn ăn uống và tầm nhìn ra cảnh biển. Sân Golf Hualalai của golf thủ Jack Nicklaus nằm ngay trong khuôn viên. Các phòng nghỉ ở đây được trang bị TV màn hình phẳng.

Các phòng hiện đại của Four Seasons Resort Hualalai tại khu di tích lịch sử Ka'upelehu được trang trí lấy cảm hứng từ Hawaii với tầm nhìn ra khuôn viên resort hay Thái Bình Dương. Đồ vệ sinh cá nhân miễn phí và bàn làm việc cũng được cung cấp trong phòng.

Du khách có thể tận hưởng hồ bơi nước mặn và khu vực chỉ dành cho người lớn cũng như spa đầy đủ dịch vụ và phòng tập thể dục rộng 1.393 m². Bãi biển cát trắng riêng của Four Seasons Resort Haulalai có những vùng nước lặng giúp bơi lội dễ dàng.

Khách sạn có 3 nhà hàng và 2 sảnh khách. Nhà hàng Beach Tree phục vụ các món ăn Ý và Địa Trung Hải bên bờ biển. Du khách có thể thưởng thức các món ăn và không khí của một tiệm bít-tết tại Hualalai Grille, tọa lạc phía trên sân golf 18 lỗ.

Resort cách bãi biển Hapuna Beach 30 phút lái xe. Công viên của Bang Akaka Falls cũng như Công viên Núi lửa Quốc gia Hawaii đều cách đó 2 giờ lái xe.

Chỗ nghỉ này là một trong những vị trí được đánh giá tốt nhất ở Kaupulehu! Khách thích nơi đây hơn so với những chỗ nghỉ khác trong khu vực.

text: This store was the best!! They had everything you could need in a grocery store and a fabulous deli. We bought short ribs to bbq at our resort. They were fantastic! Everything was fresh and really good for a quick easy to make dinner. There was also a fabulous mall with great shopping out the back door. Had a nice cold mocha drink and sat at the fountain. Highly recommend.

text: Fun place to shop. Very helpful workers, last time I was there at least two employees came up to us and asked if we needed help. Good place.

text: Smaller than other branches. Nonetheless very good place for fruits, vegetables, poke, prepared foods, groceries, wine and souvenirs, etc. shopping. Good discounted prices for Maikai member. Occasionally have very good WOW discount on selected products.

text: This is the most excellent grocery store I have all of my travels! Each cheerful person goes out of their way to help. kindness is king,  true aloha lives here

name: Shannon H. Doak Ed.D
text: This is the best place to shop if you are on the Mauna lani resort area on the Big Island. If you are trying to follow a plant-based diet they have lots of selection. If you want some really good mochi ice cream they have some awesome ones. This is a typical grocery store with a selection that you would expect to find in a supermarket. The deli is also good of you want to get something to grab and go for lunch. The shopping center that this store is located in also has various cafes and restaurants to choose from. Overall it makes staying in this particular resort more convenient.

text: Bought these beers there😀, also chocolate chips, pancake mix and a pineapple. It's a good grocery store.

name: Jeff Kinsey
text: START HERE! As far as normal grocery stores go, this is the one to pick. Make sure you sign up for their rewards program when you check out to really leverage the savings. Compared to other similar stores in the area, this will average out to cheaper. They have a decent selection of what you may want to stock up on in your hotel or condo, including alcohol, snacks, produce, and meats including fresh fish. Definitely where I would start my shopping when staying in the area.

name: Alan Pollak
text: Free samples in the Bakery, great selection, they order Passover staples when needed, great staff.

name: Michelle S.
text: Great selection and prices were reasonable for a resort-area grocery. Love that it is walking distance from so many of the complexes here. Wine selection was surprisingly good, they also have plenty of local veggies.

name: Michael Stevens
text: This is a small but well stocked grocery store in a resort area. Its expensive but way cheaper than local restaurants and WAAAY cheaper than resort restaurants. Getvpicnic stuff here and some drinks and snacks to take back to your hotel.

name: Kara Lum
text: More of a convenience store than a grocery. Small, but nice. Mostly useful to get prepared food (sandwiches, cakes, desserts, salads). Prices are not cheap, but they're not bad, either and a deal compared to buying from the hotels. Looks like the have an extensive liquor collection.

name: Jimmy Noblett
text: Be nice to have something like this back home

name: Bu Niau
text: This place has awesome local food 👌👌👌

name: John Merritt
text: Great convenient place for most everything.

name: Melissa Jensen
text: Amazing poke!

name: Skip Radey
text: Great place found everything we had on the shopping list and pretty reasonable prices. Nice and convenient to our Townhouse just a 5 minute drive and plenty of free parking.

name: Valerie Delahaye-Ippolito
text: Had the best experience with the Deli staff.  I like my deli meat in butcher paper they were kind enough to oblige.  The manager was most kind and helpful, customer service at its best.

name: Jacqueline
text: Yummy yummy everywhere. The new expansion includes a huge wine selection and good ready-made foods for a quick bite on the go. They also have beautiful displays of locals treats and delicacies.

name: Kevin Woolliams
text:
Decent resort grocery store. A lot of items in a relatively small footprint.  Some resort pricing some mainland pricing and the occasional "wow, what a deal" pricing.  Very good poke pricing.

Staff is quite friendly.

Two tips:  give your phone number to the Cashier to to get Maikai discounts and the sandwiches in the deli counter are a better deal than those in the cases around the corner.

name: Jason T
text: They have bomb poke and the people are super nice. Stop here and get food while your at mauna lani

name: Toma Mac
text: Great fish, poke, meat, vegetables, little bit pricey it is a resort area.

name: Louis Cormier
text: Really good grocery store. When the cashier asks for you phone number, give it. Even if it was an international phone number, we saved 25$!

name: Em Rabelais
text: Pretty good selection of just about everything. If you're visiting, give your phone number at check out to received membership prices. Easy, and save so much money vs resort prices.

name: Chris Parsons
text: Nice store. Gouging pricing, they know they've got tourists in a tough spot and take advantage of it.

name: Jordan Kuanoni
text: This place will save u alot of.money better than island gourmet I think

name: john oconnor
text: I always go here when I'm in Hawaii! Awesome thanks!

name: April Miyasato
text: Cashiers very friendly, Brian from Deli is is AWESOME, and selection of food, deli, & liquor.

name: Conrad Paz
text:
Convenient stop to gather up snacks and supplies before the days excursion.

A good selection of fruits, vegetables, prepared foods.  Try the spam masubi... delicious.

Very friendly staff.  Accepts Android pay.

name: W, Kamuela Santos
text: Great selection of wines and a place to buy pretty much anything you want but super expensive

name: Tianna Kaimimoku
text: Lots of fresh produce and great organic groceries

name: Ben Brewer
text: Great way to help cut some costs on vacation. All the staff was friendly and helpful, signing up for their Maika'i card is easy and gives you better prices.

name: Mark Burris
text: It has all the products we are used and close to the prices we are used to. It's kind of like a small Fred Meyers. Products seem good. Good produce, ready made food and bakery.

name: Roger Fallon
text: This is a small local grocery store serving the Mona Lani community. The selection is adequate and the prices are fairly reasonable.

name: Ralph Freeman
text: Stopped here to grab a few things while we were strolling around the shops. Store was clean and had a good variety.

name: Deborah Ardolf
text: Love the unique foods, chrese, wines, and home made soaps! Great customer service.

name: Ryan Hollenbach
text:
When I visit the big island, this is typically where I do most of my shopping.

The plaza is really nice, and several times as week they do a hula show out front next to the Grocery Store.

Make sure you get a Grocery Store Card, since you earn a special prize when you spend enough per week.

name: Anthony Chan
text: I believe this is the only supermarket available in this part of the resort town.  Hint: if you have a US phone number, be sure to sign up for their loyalty card during your first visit to the cashier.  The savings are outrageous!  It made you wonder if their business model is to profit from the tourists.

name: Chris Miles
text: Great little place with helpful friendly staff.  Each morning we stopped in for our beach lunch from the deli.  After the beach we grabbed bevies and snacks fore the condo.

name: Jacqueline M
text: They underwent a renovation recently but expanded the charcuterie, bakery, meat, and beverage areas. It still is a small store though, patience is key. They are carrying more select items like organics and higher end items than the Waimea location but it is still the least expensive option in all the resort areas. Yup, the secret is the maikai card. It's just your phone #, earn the rewards certificates for every $250 you spend. They don't expire. Tip your housekeeper them, but don't just tip them this :D. Good bakery, fresh donuts (when you catch aunty). My advice, get the small stuff and ready mades here, get the big stuff at Costco. Alcohol snobs will find something to sip here or island gourmet (or costco).

name: Doug Hilo
text: Now THIS is a great store for its location in  posh area...cheeses and wines from all over and gourmet stuff on every shelf...well stocked fast and efficient..

name: Nathan Shults
text: Good for a quick grocery run.

name: Michael Ayres
text: Bit spendy, but much less so than anything else in the area.  Good selection 👍

name: Julie Ahearn
text: We stopped in for a quick poke bowl and weren’t impressed. Cheap but with poke you get what you pay for. Very friendly staff.

name: Christopher
text: Everything you need. Sandwiches, hot bentos, a roasted chicken, poke, salads, fruits, uncooked meat, snacks, towels, flip flops, sunscreen and an amazing alcohol selection.  Be advised though, Milk, cheese and bread are gonna be pricey!

name: Ferol Kolons
text: Great place to grab a quick lunch. Great small market with everything and then some.

name: Jason Kwan
text: So convenient if you're staying around Mauna Lani, Hapuna, or Mauna Kea resorts. Now you don't have to drive all the way to Waikoloa for groceries. They also make spam musubi in the morning. Get there before 11:30 in the morning before they're all gone  :-)

I LOVE the mochi ice cream (many different flavors, all good, but in particular, the passion fruit is awesome!), and there was some chocolate covered coffee and macadamia nut bark from Hawaii that is just awesome!

name: Matt Lamon
text:
Great for people in the Mauna Lani resort for its convenient location and the non-resort prices.

There is a deli which I haven't tried, but it looks good. I've tried alot of prepared foods here that are so-so, however I'm guessing the deli is better than most of their other prepared foods. Beware of the cheapie bakery items. You get what you pay for.

There is some sort of a sushi area...  but don't expect to be wowed by the sushi here.... its mainly cheap packaged stuff like you would find in most grocery stores in the Islands.

Produce selection is good, especially for a resort area. I was able to get fresh veggies, a salad mix, and fresh fruit.

Overall this is a great place to grab a few sandwiches, chips, fruit / veggies for a day exploring.

Wailana Ka'ahanui Ahuna
text:
Second time post covid that we've been to Sansei Waikoloa. Never disappointed.
Make those reservations, especially with a bigger party of 5 pax or more. The early bird is worth it! The food is great, satisfied for sure. Our service - the general manager doing temp checks as you walk in, the hostess with our reservation, the server who sat us, our server (Kawehi) is accommodating, attentive, and thee best with that aloha spirit,  request her always, if possible. Do not forget to save room for the best brownie ice cream dessert 😋😋😋
Will be back again soon 🙌👍👌 Mahalo nui Sansei Waikoloa

name: Meiliana Sintaraga
text:
We were recommended to try this place, but to my surprise, it was just a much of a disappointment rather. The place is located in a nice area, I would think with "$$$" on the menu expense eating, it's fine dine quality type of venue.
I'm results, the food wasn't as I had expected, the service wasn't that great either. I came in with open mind and tried some of the recommended dish from the server, I ordered the calamari, the shrimp cake and fish, then my friend ordered some sushi rolls.
To be honest, I enjoyed stealing some of her sushi rather than the dish I had ordered.
When I placed my order, I had asked to get my calamari to come first, but instead I got my main dish. The main dish I requested to have the fish grilled medium done, and I ended up having to eat raw parts, mostly. Then the calamari had more of the tentacles than the rings, and the sauce were too sweet...
When I had told the server about the fish not being cooked the way I requested, she got snippy with me and told me that the fish were meant to be raw, and I should've told her to have the fish cooked instead. Then when I mentioned to her that they should've at least pointed out where the shrimp cake is sitting on the packed fried noodles, that would've helped with dish presentation. She gotten very rude and just brushed off without even being considerate of a kind suggestion for few folks whom are unfamiliar with the dishes served. The only star I'm giving is for decorations and the decent sushi I got to try. Not sure if I'll come back.

name: James Riordan
text: Very popular place for sushi and assorted dishes. We had a reservation which was good because it was very crowded and we were seated promptly. Atmosphere was lively and upbeat and our server was very good. Sushi was very fresh and delicious.

name: Ken Wong
text: Stopped by for some delicious sushi. Sat at the bar and had great service from the sushi chef. She was quick and very nice. Would come back again for more delicious sushi.

name: Sai P
text: Nice ambience and variety sushi and fusion food. Expensive but worth a visit. Friendly staff. Make sure to reserve in advance.

name: Don Sien
text: Food and staff is always excellent. Some of the most unique and delicious sushi around. Prices reasonable (very reasonable Sunday & Monday evenings!) We always enjoy sansei at least once every time we are on island!

name: AJ DeAngelo
text: Great sushi. Good ambiance!

name: bbaboo U
text: Excellent food, very fresh, unique dishes.Service was very good, knowledgeable about all the dishes. Would return.

name: frank klatil
text: Food was okay, BUT upon our arrival, we were told that if we sit at the bar and place our order before 18:30, we will get a 25% discount. They even explained which menu items were included in this offer. When we received the bill, there was no discount applied. When we asked about this issue, the bartender said that she would fix it. When she presented the second bill, it was almost identical to the first one. How did she performed such mathematical magic? She simply rewarded herself with a 20% tip. Wow. What a nerve Kyli D. has.

name: Erin Hinz
text: Great sushi and quick service! Love to eat at this place whenever I'm on the island.

name: Carlos Loslos
text: Amazing service, good food, and pricey! A large group of friends and I ate here for a birthday celebration and we had fun. We ordered lots of appetizers, steak, onion rings, and shrimp which were a very good. We were there for their happy hour which made some of the items on the menu discounted. The selection of happy hour item was very small. They brought out a crème brûlée for the birthday guy that was delicious!

name: Chris Hinshaw
text: Good bordering on great food. Lots of selection, Japanese, Hawiian and steakhouse. Good selection of beers, wines and cocktails. A little noisy but then it's a popular place!

name: Sinjin Lewis
text:
Greg was our server and he was top notch. Excellent description of all menu items and specials, and very personable.

We had the Panko Crusted Ahi, the Ahi Tataki, the Yellow Submarine Roll, and the Tako (octopus) - all of them were SOO good we were licking the plates after all the food was gone...outstanding flavors and textures to them all. Cannot praise the kitchen staff enough for their execution of all these dishes.

Muchos Mahalos to the whole staff - I have to say that we came in with only a half-hour before they closed (I don’t encourage this behavior, but it is what it is) and they were incredibly accommodating and didn’t flinch to take excellent care of us regardless.

name: Kimberly Fierley
text: Worth every penny.  Great service, amazing food!  Treat yo' self.

name: Allana Kate
text: Food are great ... Service need more attention... I ordered calamari but no sauce given ..wait until sauce came but too late ..  and another time for to wait entree for 45 minutes .. sushi 's thier signature dishes " ISsei Combination" . The timing is too late in between order .. my wife food served first and finished.my order sushi still waiting after and 1:05! At last!

name: Crystal Callista
text:
Terrible wait service, awful atmosphere. The only good thing about this restaurant was their karaoke and even that was lacking. No song selection, the food and drink were priced pretty high and were overall disappointing. I came here for my birthday, and will not be returning!

However, shout out to the guy running karaoke. Super friendly and did an excellent job of making everyone feel welcome.

name: C Peterson
text: Freshest sushi I've ever had. The food was spectacular, however it is more expensive than run-of-the-mill sushi restaurants. The quality speaks for itself. I would highly recommend making a reservation as well. My family arrived early for our 7:30 reservation, and we were actually seated right after we walked in! Overall, a great experience and I can't wait to come back again.

name: Fraser Street
text: EARLY BIRD SPECIAL - from 5:30-6:00 gets you 25% off. That combined with above average sushi gets five stars.

name: Sandman 96744
text: Excellent food and service.

name: Jessica Doolittle
text: We come here often.  My favorites are the Asian shrimp cake, dynamite shrimp, and most of the specialty rolls.   The special rolls of the day are sometimes good, but not always worth the money...  they have an early bird special from 5:30-6 that's 25% off and Friday and Saturday they have a late night happy hour 9:30(?)-12 that's 50% off.  They also have karaoke!😉 if they have their special miso with the lobster and the truffle oil, get it!

name: Miriam Moylan
text: Sadly, this Restaurant is Closed until further notice.

name: Dad4rules Alderson
text: This is a sushi gem! Great food! Super fresh and well balanced. Great flavors! A must!

name: Toni Kaui
text: Discovered the Early Bird special and thoroughly enjoyed our dinner and evening. We had the best server as well, Chelsea! We didn't get any pictures of the food because it quickly went in our bellies, but we did get one of the family! On the table is the Dynamite shrimp and the Panko ahi roll.  A trip to Waikoloa should always include a trip to Sansei!

name: Gerald Takase
text: Excellent food, service.   Pacific Regional c UK cuisine at its best

name: Sean Salimian
text: The best ramen I've ever had crab ramen was insane text your taste noodles broth everything was perfect huge portions all the roles and other stuff you got here is going to be good also. It's so good I don't want to tell anybody about it so it's not crowded

text: Delicious ! We tried multiple dishes, family style. The butter fish,  beef filet, and fried ice cream were my favorites !

text: Got here at 5:25. Did not have a reservation. The place was empty. They would not seat us. If you want to eat here (even early) you need a reservation.

text: A decent Japanese place here, although the oyster dish is a bit strange, oysters are removed from their shells and served with salad...??

name: Terangi B_96743
text: We didnt have a reservation but the hostess said we could sit at the bar so we did. The bartenders were great. Very attentive, and were always looking and asking to make sure we were good. Food runners were also very good, and as always the food was excellent!

name: danyelle goitia
text: We came to this place on a recommendation. We were told the ribeye was a must have. It is 22 ounces and just way too much for my husband and I to eat. He ordered the house prepared steak and I ordered the crab ramen. Uhhhhh my goodness! Did we choose well. The steak has perfectly roasted garlic and was seared beautifully. The crab ramen was amazing! It was salty and flavorful and so yummy! There was crab in every bite. We ordered the dynamite shrimp, tempura onions and a crunchy roll. The appetizers were okay compared to the meal.

name: Deanna Yick
text: I dream about their butterfish, so good. And the fried ice cream is a guilty pleasure, not to be missed!

text: Awesome selection of maybe 10 different kids of poke to choose from, lobster cake burger was great, and nice that they have a kids menu too.  Tourists should not be fooled by the cheap plastic tables and chairs, you're going to have to go to a little spot like this to find the best poke.

text: We live eating here. Their steak is always perfectly prepared.

name: Cam Carson
text: The food was fresh and deliciously prepared! Being right on the ocean to see the amazing sunset was wonderful too!

name: Karen Zhao
text:
Came for the Monday night 50% off special. Just like the Waikiki location, they are well organized. They take the your name and party size when you’re in line and plan out the seating chart. The wait staff is incredible. It’s amazing to see them work in what you would think would be a chaotic situation. Food comes out promptly, and you are well taken off. I’d come again every week if I lived here.

I arrived around 4:30 and was in the middle of the line.

name: Andrew Herman
text: Service was good but all the food was bland. Presentation was nice but just extremely mediocre at best

name: Lambda Mu
text: Overpriced and underwhelming. I had an appetizer and a sushi entree and I was still hungry afterwards. Tourist trap.

name: Jim Thornburg
text: I loved my dinner at Sansei! Very fresh tasting sushi rolls, fun yet elegant feel to the restaurant, respectable drink menu, friendly staff. It was definitely one of the best places to eat in the Waikoloa beach area.

text: Went to purchase a wireless router. Even though they were pretty business I was met with David who help me locate the router and explained the difference features and functionality. I feel like everytime I go to Best Buy I learn something new. During my check out I saw my favorite Best Buy employee,  Davin. He's always so happy and helpful.

name: Holly Ann Holcomb
text:
This was my first time visiting this location. It was much larger than I expected and has a huge selection. However, it was cluttered and dirty in some areas. Boxes were lined up on the floor and I couldn't help but think, you have hundreds of thousands of merchandise in the store and you can't afford a shelf? Even though there was a large vacuum section, I was tripping over vacuum boxes in the refrigerator area... Why?

Also, with the insane anount of inventory on the floor, I was expecting to find the one item I came for... Nope. I found a laptop sleeve area that was disorganized, disheveled, and lacking. There wasn't much to choose from and I couldn't find anything in my size. It was either too big or too small and I had to read each item description to figure out the pricing. On top of all that, the security alarm next to the laptop sleeve section was going off non stop and no one seemed to care. They were finally turning it off as I left.

I was at office depot before but looked online and decided to give best buy a try. I should have just purchased at office depot. Lesson learned.

Overall, I can now say I've visited but unless I had no other option, I wouldn't return.

I'm not sure why this store gets a bad rap. I've been to this store more than a handful of times and I've always got what I needed. The staff is always nice and answers all my questions.

I think there are too many know it alls that don't actually know anything. Don't let it change the way you think of this place.

Don't forget they price match!
