name: Joanna Mendoza
text: We go here every time we are in Hilo. The menu has an excellent selection of items so that the entire family will find something they like. This last trip for lunch we enjoyed the chicken sandwich and a spinach and avocado salad with chicken. Both were excellent. We split s Pineapple Pow with the alcohol on the side. A must try at least once!

name: Kelly Bartlett
text: Don't miss this fantastic open air restaurant! Everything on the menu is wonderful and the staff are as friendly as you will find. Highly recommend if you are on the island and don't miss out on the blast of flavor in all the colorful drinks!

name: Heather Endres
text: SO FUN! Wonderful atmosphere, fun wait staff, and live music was the cherry on top! Order a drink out of a pineapple! It is pricey but such a fun part of the experience. Located in the middle of town so it is central to even more great experiences!

name: Parnaz Rad
text: Live music and all food there is pretty good. We have tried most of burgers and Pupus. Everyone working there is super kind and helpful!

name: Oren Rae
text: Amazing food at an amazing place. The place was super busy when we went. Even then, they still have us excellent service and were very nice and friendly. Definitely recommend coming here if you are looking for a nice night out in Hilo.

name: Rajesh Verma
text: Pineapple Pow was great. French onion soup tasted freshly made. Poke had great flavor. Shrimp was good.

name: Laura Phillips
text:
We loved lunch at Hilo Pineapples restaurant today !! Oh so Ono 😁
Our server Mo was friendly, efficient, and helpful. I already ate half my pineapple cheeseburger before I remembered to take a picture. My husband shared but also had their yummy clam chowder. We love this wonderful establishment and will be back 🤙

name: Shikha Bhan
text: The scene here is lively and fun. The food and drinks were pretty average. The scallop entree was really disappointing - overly sweet without even a hint of salt. The scallops were poor quality and obviously previously frozen. Others at the table enjoyed their food more than I did, so their plates average out the stars to a 3.

name: Parisa S
text:
Pineapple burger was excellent. As an island burger should be.

Portobello burger was okay. Better with added avocado. Salad greens were really fresh.

Pineapple drink is a must - mostly for fun. The drink itself wasn’t the best, but the serving cup and set up was well worth it.

Very friendly staff.

name: Laura Pearson
text: I loved the drinks in a pineapple! And the atmosphere is fun. We went on a Saturday and they had a singer/guitar performer that livened things up. The food was decent. I had the pineapple burger, which was good, but could have used more pineapple. I would recommend a reservation otherwise you might have to wait 30-45min, but there is some limited bar seating that you can snag sometimes.

name: Alita Hawksworth
text:
Spent 9 days on Hawai'i and this is my one and only 5 star review.
Making the reservation online was easy and highly recommended.
Every staff member encountered was friendly.
All the food was delicious and high quality.
Live music was a great touch.
The whole experience was top notch and will be advising people to go here!!

name: Lisa Oberle
text: HIGHLY HIGHLY Recommend this wonderful establishment. The food is out of this world the service is so accommodating and incredible. And the drinks are fabulous you cannot come to Hilo without visiting this place. The manager is incredible all the staff are working continuously cleaning, and sanitizing.   Just a wonderful incredible experience it's a must-see.

name: Kimi Sycamore
text:
I loved the coconut crusted ahi. It was so yummy. Everything on the menu looked good I can’t wait to try other dishes.
I did take out and it was fine. My only problem was the sauce was really runny I think it was due to the vegetables and it all being in a to go container. I would recommend putting the vegetables in a separate container so it doesn’t make the crusted fish soggy in the container.

name: Jenn Louie
text: Fantastic service- truly delightful! Super busy happy hour for good reason.

name: Ramin Ostad
text: Delicious and super sweet staff. Open air. Fresh catch was amazing. Pineapple salsa is spot on. Didn't try the drinks but they look amazing!

name: michael exstein
text:
Absolutely terrific place, both food wise and service wise. Most of us had one of the daily specials. These were a salmon cobb salad, fresh greens were terrific salmon well marinaded, pot roast tacos were delicious accompanied with bean and rice, finally had ceasar salad and seafood rice bowl. The restaurant itself is open and comfortable in area that has seen better times. Can't wait to go back.

I love you too restaurant restaurant itself

😊

name: Sonal Kaulkar
text: Ordered the burger which was good and the coconut mussels , cooked perfectly but the broth was a bit bland. Anyways on letting them know I was offered a free dessert wherein I chose the coconut one and that was good.

name: John Abplanalp
text: Full service upscale restaurant with an open air dining area.  A few fewer tables now due to Covid, but the service and good food are still the same.  Great place.

name: Miss Mel Kaai
text: Came here for pupus and drinks, there was live music and our waitress was very attentive. I came here on a Sunday however if you come on Thursdays Dos XX is $4 draft

name: Dushyant Maheshwary
text: Went here for dinner on a weekday evening. The place was busy, but fortunately, we had a reservation, so didn't have to wait. We had the Hamakua Ali'i Mushrooms to start with. The dish was quite flavorful thanks to the garlic butter sauce. I got the roasted vegetable pasta and substituted the marinara sauce with pesto on recommendation from our server - Linnsey. The pasta was pretty good, too. The service was quick and the staff was friendly. The ambience is nice. I wish there were more vegetarian options. It was a good experience overall.

name: Jake Westerback
text: The best meal on out vacation and possibly of my life. The staff was so nice and the food was AMAZING. I ate the Hilo Local Plate, cocktail sampler, and the triple lilikoi pie - if nothing else you have to order the pie.

name: Dark Tonic
text: Standard food with a 5 star atmosphere. It's the honest review. Everything is amazing but the food is good enough to pay the price.

name: Kristin Klope
text: I am only giving 4 stars because it was crowded when we went. It was probably due to the cruise ship being in port but other than that this place was wonderful. We had the pork and ono. Both were delicious. The staff was very kind and all working very hard to accommodate everyone. The open air dining was also a plus to enjoy the nice weather outside.

name: Meenu Choudhary
text: The food was amazing! Definitely a must do in hilo.

name: Tiffany Wyatt
text: Atmosphere, server, and Pineapple Pow drink were wonderful. Veggie pasta was quite bland for the price.

name: Chris Sirinop
text: Good food great service. I went on a Sunday night and got a seat at the bar. I had a Kabi rib and pina colada.

name: Sean Kirkpatrick
text: The happy hour jalapeño poppers were excellent, the flesh of the pepper was still crisp and flavorful.

name: clifford lobberegt
text: Our last night in Hilo, been saving this one. Every thing was GREAT! Starting with the live music, cocktails, appetizers, salad and main courses. No complaints from any of us.

name: m raji
text: Average menu, very pricey menu. Good pineapple drinks

name: Kat M.
text: Food was delicious. Open and outdoor air dining.

name: Kirt Reeves
text: This place is WELL KNOWN, for esquisitely plated food, awesome staff, don't let the exterior fool you,this might be Hilo's best restaurant.

name: John Hannan
text: Long wait of 45 minutes to be seated on a Friday night.  Another patron suggested that it would be worth the wait.  I'm glad I did, service and food was outstanding.  Open air restaurant on a corner site.  Very trendy place. If I lived here,  I would eat here at least once a week.

name: Laura Knight
text: Great place to eat. I got the fish sandwich with garlic mash.  BF got the seafood pasta an my son got the chicken pasta all very good. We also got the garlic cheese fries loaded as an appetizer. An a fee drinks. An one without alcohol.

name: Daniel Hines
text: Great service. Awesome food with a real local flavor. Everybody's good was amazing. I would definetly recommend when you are in Hilo.

name: Peggy Grebstad
text: Aloha richness is found here,  so sweet...Excellent food and the freshest island fish plates are  perfectly executed, fresh air dining is pono- Licious, mahalo Pineapples!!!

name: Matt Curtis
text: Fantastic drinks and food, friendly service! Lunch was perfect

name: Will Smithwick
text: Nice staff - good beers on tap. Good food as well.

name: Colin Combest
text: Great food, awesome service and live music. Drinks are very reasonably priced. Food is big portions. Best food in the shopping center there in front of Hilo Bay. Must try the house beer and the pineapple drink you can get with or without alcohol.

name: Lt. Colonel David K. Swendiman
text: Delicious!  And the ambience is superb.  Open air and friendly staff

name: Marie Rice
text:
I wanna say I would love to give a 5 star review. Unfortunately I can not; although my service was excellent! The food was not so great, I was very sad. I got the Kalua pork nachos, and my friend got the Asian shrimp salad special. I was very disappointed with the nachos. She said her salad was fine, but nothing to write home about; only 2 shrimp with basic green leaf lettuce and cabbage - Oh and lots of red onion! My nachos were very bland. The cheese tasted old, had that hint of funk. The guac tasted like it was frozen and from subway, the pork, the whole 2 ounces of it was not flavorful at all. Most of the flavor came from the  pineapple in the salsa. Even the jalapenos were mushy and tasted like they hadn't been rotated and rotten :(
If I go back I would definitely go for the drinks. They looked excellent! The bartender was busy and pumping out those delicious, mouthwatering delights!

name: Julia Cassen
text: We were seated immediately, served quickly and efficiently and our food was delicious. It's a nice breezy open air place. The wait staff is exceptional. I'd definitely go back!

name: Lena Godwin
text: The service was good and the guy playing the guitar and singing was nice, but otherwise I wouldn't come back. The food was okay. Definitely not worth the price. The drink I ordered tasted like watered down vodka, I couldn't even drink it.

name: Calley H
text: Okay the food was amazing,  the service was amazing.  But the hostess was horrible,  she lied and said she called us but we showed her our call log she didn't care.

name: Brooke Holderbaum
text: Unique menu items and streetcorner location make this a fun place to meet up with friends.  House pineapple beer and locally made ice cream were excellent bookends to our fish and chips meal.

name: Jaynee Curto
text: Nice patio setting and good Mai Tai's.

name: 4 Da Love of Chocolate hannah
text: Fish ,massive shrimp and both kine french frys where amazing. But management is somthing to be desired.

name: Kendrick Davis
text: Fun Atmosphere. The night we went there was a musician playing a guitar and singing. The food was tasty, served hot and well prepared. The fish was fresh and all 5 of us enjoyed our meal. Brownie dessert was large and yummy.

name: Austin T
text: The food and atmosphere here is great! I got the burger and my wife got the fish and chips. I  liked the fish and chips even though I don't like seafood.

name: Genna Lasko
text: Great experience and delicious food. It was pouring rain so there was no wait at the time we showed up. The menu had a unique selection of burgers, salads, seafood, and appetizers.

name: DeeAnne Clardy
text: Good service wonderful food family friendly

name: Sean F Gallagher
text: We had a great time. They only had us at every other table to ensure social distancing. We had chicken nachos which were solid and the caprese which was fantastic. My wife also got a flight of daqueris which were very tasty.

name: Anita Ellis
text: Beautiful pineapple 🍍drink was delicious.

name: Nick Tango
text:
Super friendly atmosphere!

Really enjoyed our service. I had the lamb chops and it was very flavorful and I enjoyed every bite of it!

You definitely need to drop by while in town.

name: Yajaira Pagán
text: I love this place; the food is the best! Its a delicious!

name: Ivan Pavzyuk
text: Delicious food! Great service. Live music. Barely walked out. Highly recommend this experience. I had teriyaki flank steak and it was melting in my mouth. Also mushroom appetizer was amazing and was a meal itself.

name: Jamie
text: Excellent service! A little pricey for my liking, but definitely worth a go. I had the Hawaiian burger. It was alright, but not something special. I would stick to fish or other dishes.

name: Yvonne Cervantes
text: Nice, friendly staff, good grub. Open on Tuesdays!👍🏻😄

name: Marcin Sieniek
text: Great food, drinks and service. The location could have been nicer but otherwise it's great. Also open air is a plus given covid.

name: Charlotte Malan
text: Open air, friendly service, local music, incredible food!! Try this place! (Pineapple pow drink, and flank steak pictured)

name: stan yu
text: Massive portions and good bang for your buck. Importantly, food was really good. I had the grilled chicken pasta. Good texture and nice light pesto sauce. The black olives added a nice touch to the dish. Nicely decorated place and great staff. Also had a bite of the shrimp ravioli. Also a great choice. Really filling and good flavors

name: Gwen Peterson
text: Everything was good . Very friendly staff.

name: Patricia Arterbury
text:
I love this place. This was our second time to come. We live in Kona.  The food is excellent,
The people are all so nice and very friendly.
We will be coming back. Its the place to eat in Hilo.

name: Wa Da Skoop
text: Friendly staff! Nice to be able to dine out again. Tables are separated to in order to following social distancing guidelines. Must wear a mask upon entering but you may remove your mask upon being seated at your table. Enjoyed the live music on Saturday evening.

name: Rebecca McLaws
text: The lava burger was delicious!

name: Rebecca Smythe
text: Great atmosphere. Delicious food with heaps of menu options. We had fair few people in town recommend going here and ordering a Pineapple Pow... So glad we did.  Joey makes a bloody good cocktail 👌🏼

name: Randy Flinders
text: Awesome island vibe and some of the best food in Hilo!  Try the lava burger!

name: Natalia Zinoveva
text: Delicious food and live music. A perfect spot for a dinner.

name: Bruce Albrecht
text: Tasty food, great service, small dining room right on the street. One of Hilo's better casual dining restaurants

name: Shiva Arari
text: Mushroom app shrimp app and beef app all superb. Fresh catch was awesome as well. Service. Tres bien!

name: Rhindress Music
text: Nice beach vibe here with very nice servers. Love the pineapple lager! Good deals at the bar during happy hour. Otherwise, a fairly spendy place to lunch!

name: David Schlecht
text: Great vibes. Open air restaurant. Got to taste a really good pineapple burger. It was not cooked enough for me but I ate half! Lol. I ordered it med. But that was a bloody bun under meatpatty. I was with friends. Our friend wanted to buy so I wasn't going ruin mood with return of burger to cook. I have super high anxiety. So it wasn't happening. I don't like bloody hamburger. I like steak a little more towards med/ rare. But I like burger dryer. Bun shouldn't be soaked in red blood. Kinda gross. Super messy to eat. Soggy bottom bun. Lol. I would totally go back! They were super awesome servers and like I said vibes is what Hawaii is ALL about! Aloha Love!!

name: L Nguyen
text: Great service. This place gets busy so for big parties you might need to wait.  I had the special pepperoni pizza burger with a pineapple beer (I think that's what it's called) and my wife had the shrimp tacos and to wash it down a spicy bloody Mary.

name: Gayle Larson
text: Menu had a variety of choices. The food was excellent with fresh Hawaiian flavors. We will be back.

name: Robert Colbert
text: Great food and service. Covid friendly and clean. We enjoyed the live music, and the atmosphere was wonderful.

name: Arthur Akau
text: Having driven past this restaurant many times, it’s always packed with a long line of people waiting.  But since it’s the final evening of the 2018 Merrie Monarch there were a few open tables.  The staff was friendly, we received the food quickly and the portions were very generous (we actually split the entrees).  We throughly enjoyed the Seafood Pasta and Coconut Crusted Fish.  Be sure to try the Pineapple Pow too!  We’ll definitely be back for more!

name: Anthony L
text: Great dinners at a great price, chill open atmosphere, food was really good and fresh tasting. The cocktails were a little weak for $10/each, I don’t think I even felt the drink even on an empty stomach. Great place otherwise!

name: Akshaya Kumar
text:
Extremely cute place! Waitresses are very warm and friendly! Instantly felt welcome!
Jules was our server for dinner! She was amazing! Have great recommendations!

They have a separate vegan menu with good options!

We had vegetable stir fry for main course and mushroom appetizer! Both were so delicious! And the sweet potato fries!! Ahhh!! So so sooooooo good!

Restaurant is more on the expensive side but ambience is so lively and energetic! They even had LIVE music!

Loved the experience!

Pineapple POW??? MUST TRY! It’s presented in an extremely cute way!!!!!!

name: Sarah McQuillan
text: Friendly and genuine service. We got fish tacos, burgers, fish bowl, and fish and chips - they were all delicious. Great place to stop after visiting the volcano park.

name: KC
text: A great restaurant in "old" downtown Hilo.  They seem to specialize in Local products from their produce, meats, fresh catch & even beers!  Not only is the food great but probably the best staff in Hilo.  So far, everyone who has served us on the occasions that we've been there has been knowledgeable, professional and very friendly. Priscilla served us on this occasion and rattled off a list of specials that seemed to be a dozen items. I made her repeat it a couple times and her smile never flinched. My sister & I ended up splitting a Fish & Chips that consisted of Beer Battered Ono (wahoo) with Sweet Potato fries and Cole Slaw.  It came on Two large platters that I thought was two orders.  Cooked just right with fish firm but still very moist. We also had the Crispy Spring Rolls (Chicken, avacado, bacon, tomato with Jack & Manchego cheese) and a must have appetizer is the Hamakua Ali'i mushrooms. They're meaty like Portabella mushrooms but with a Rich flavor and served sauteed with tomatoes & garlic butter making a great thing even better.  We washed everything down with a Lilikoi (passion fruit) mimosa and a couple of Big Island Brewhaus beers.  Fantastic lunch at a relatively affordable price is why it's one of my favorite restaurants in Hilo.

name: PIMARINE
text: Open place to dine in with a full bar. Expensive to most

name: CharlieBrew Too
text: This restaurant is very open and has a pretty nice view. The pupus are unique in flavor as Well as style. This picture is the nochos. You will see that the sauce is not ordinary. The bar is well stocked and the bartenders were very nice. We talked story and their service was great.

name: Alex Draper
text: The service was super great, and they were very accommodating with our large group. The food was very delicious and the servings were very large.

name: Chas Kidder
text: Food was good, service was so so. A few tables around us, and including us had wrong orders but we weren't worried about it. Cheese puffs are an absolute must. We ordered them twice. Open air atmosphere added bonus.

name: Ollie M
text: Good food and a fun place to eat.

name: Alan Hu
text: Very vibrant restaurant, food was great and they have pineapple beer!

name: N L
text:
If you can handle spice, then try fish dynamite. I was surprised to find the dish so rich in flavor. It had ahi rice and sautéed vegetables in a mix of spices. Pina no colada was also a great find. Better than their pow wow drink.

Fish burger with fresh mahi mahi was crispy and fresh. I enjoyed it. The place was packed during lunch time. I found their fish dishes slightly better than the Da Kitchen but then its not like I am comparing apples to apples as the dishes were different.

Service was a little bit on the slow side because of the busy lunch time hours. Expect to wait in the line to be seated.

Parking is difficult to find during peak hours. If you plan on doing grocery then park your car at the grocery store parking lot.

name: Dom R
text: Good place. Always busy. Food a bit pricey.

name: Sam Gao
text: Good food, friendly servers, and good vibes

name: Fariah Amber
text:
So it was my husband who really wanted to come here! We did finally get a chance to, after making a reservation! I highly recommend making one because the first time we tried there was about  a 1.5 hour wait! When I did make a reservation we were seated in about 7 minutes! It gets very very busy!
We had the scallops as starters. I don't usually like scallops because of the texture but these were excellent. I guess I haven't had good ones before? I highly recommend them!
I got the kalbi and an extra side of mac salad. I loved it! It was so flavorful and is a HUGE helping!! I had it for lunch the next day and still had a whole strip left!!
Hubby got the volcano fish plate. It was made with mahi mahi and had a nice hot sauce on it ( not the regular Tabasco or other store bought hot sauce! ) . It was delicious too!
For dessert we had the coconut pie which was scrumptious! A really good way to end this delicious meal!

name: Taiana Kapeli-Kahaleua
text: Omg da food was da bomb,the waiter nd waitress were jus as expected,caring nd knowledgeable...

name: Eileen A. McAllister
text: Great people, great food, great atmosphere!

name: keoranda kun
text: Pineapple pow is da best , my steak rice is tasty while my husband get the Hilo local plate and the brew beer kona . The place is amazing with very nice employees.

name: Andrew Evans
text: The staff is extremely friendly and attentive. The food was delicious and came out quick. It is a little on the more pricy side but worth it.

name: Melissa Jensen
text: One of our favorite restaurants so far on the big island. Fantastic  service and the food came quickly, very hot, and it tasted so good! I had the coconut crusted Mahi mahi with jasmine rice, amazing. We both enjoyed the dragon fruit lychee cider. The locatin is good but on a very busy street, the street noise was pretty loud. We would absolutely go back though.

name: Shelli Buda
text: Excellent food and service! We will be going back!!!❤️🤙

name: Maxime Cescau
text: Great food, pineapple golden ales and ambiance

name: Itai Ezra
text:
Very nice place, with a great vibe.
Food was good. Very interesting and unique flavors.

name: Jeanette Asgekar
text: Wonderful, Fabulous food, great servers...absolutely loved it...

name: Angelo
text: Awesome menu. Something for all tastes and diet restrictions including kid friendly choices. All food was delish!!

name: Roberta Kim
text: Really great food...friendly service!

name: joseph terry
text: Great food, atmosphere and experience!! I had the coconut crusted fish and it is to die for.

name: James McIntyre
text:
Party place. Great bartender
He's got it down. If someone else tries don't.young man no hair. Sorry...

name: cruise trek
text:
Hi!
We had dinner here for the first time.... goodness!! I have traveled the world in first class and not so.  The food, the staff and the live local one artist playing live music --  everything was absolutely lovely!  Staying here for a couple months... this will be our go to place!

Thank you!

name: Khurram Ijaz
text: Food & drinks were top notch, delicious, and customer service was A1.  Reasonably priced and a good atmosphere.

name: Private Private
text: I enjoyed the flank steak but others didn't like the fish (swordfish) and chips... lacked flavor. The environment was great as there was live music and an open breeze style restaurant.

name: Amy J
text: Yum yum yum!! Great food, great staff and awesome drinks. Not only they were aesthetically pleasing, it was also very tasty. We ordered the hilo local fav and pineapple burger and would definitely come back for more.

name: Malie Carvalho
text: The food and service was great.

name: Chui Ming Tang
text: Cute ambiance at this restaurant with nice live music. We had the pumpkin curry, pineapple burger and Monkey’s lunch drink. The pumpkin curry is good but needs some salt. The monkey’s lunch (mac nut milk blended with apple and banana with caramel and whip cream) is so pretty. Very sweet and has a nutty aftertaste. You might want to have this after your meal or you won’t taste much else. They also had some interesting beers here like dragonfruit lychee which we didn’t try.

name: Randy Massner
text: Great good great service

name: Andara Plavi
text: One of our favorite spots to eat in Hilo. We're always impressed with the food quality and quantity! Delicious.

name: Bernadette Parker
text: Generous and delicious. The staff are amazing,  special shout out to Stacey who is always warm and welcoming.  Kitchen staff present beautiful plates and absolutely delicious food! Bar does a great job too!

name: Dannie Eaves
text: Food was awsome. Drinks were great will be back.

name: kameron tsue
text: The chicken wings are awesome, Fries Are thick-cut, service is outstanding, staff is very friendly.

name: Vaune Loh
text: Love the food. 😁 Cheesy garlic fries, teriyaki steak

name: Chucky Chuck
text: The location of this restaurant is better than the food. The staff here are awesome.

name: ernie ramirez
text: Great food and atmosphere

name: Elizabeth Sepke
text: One of Hilo’s best! This lively downtown open-air restaurant frequently has live music. Usually a short wait. Great fish entrees!

name: Amanda Lavoie
text: This place has the friendliest staff. Everyone we spoke with there seemed genuinely happy to have us in their establishment. We had a spicy jalapeno margarita (yum!) and a mai tai (okay). Both drinks were ridiculously strong! Portions are huge! The fish dish we got was tasty, though fried, and we would have preferred grilled. The Hilo local plate was piled high with food and was yummy, but enough food for 2-3 people. Overall, a great place to eat if you have a night in town, but it's not the fanciest.

name: Florian S
text: Great place for a quick bite. Pineapple burger is very tasty. A must is the Pineapple POW - carries a punch with alcohol!

name: Dien H
text: Great staff, atmosphere and great food!  I enjoyed my time here sitting at the bar.

name: Bex
text: Oh my,  oh my! Divine to the sky! Quick service,  well-seasoned food, crossfit French fries with a dip that had just a hint of spicy,  sweet yet tangy lilikoi hoisin wings,  slurping good onion soup.... heavenly!

name: Tyler Ritz
text:
Great staff, great atmosphere, great seafood.
The scallops were out of this world; the portions were great (came with a nice salad and baguette), and they were perfectly cooked.
The Pineapple Pow was delicious, even better with the alcohol but still good without.
Only downside was the burger. Being so good at so many things, you would think they would make a decent burger or just remove it from the menu. I’ll just blame myself for getting a burger at a seafood restaurant.

name: Zach Green
text: The food was great. I asked our waitress if she owned the place because she was so on top of things. She said she was the manager. Obviously the owner hired right. It's nice to see a hands on manager working

name: Eric DeGroot
text: The local plate is amazing! I would suggest this Everytime.

name: Hawaii Ski
text:
I found this place on Yelp, it had nice reviews and photos.   We parked on the outskirts of Hilo because we were afraid that we won't find parking, but as it turns out there is plenty of street parking close to the restaurant.  I love the open air feel of the restaurant, the walls were open on two sides, with the view onto downtown Hilo and the ocean.   It was one of the few places open in Hilo on Sunday, and it was packed.   Thankfully we didn't have to wait too long on a table for five of us, maybe like 5 minutes or so.   Our waitress, Renee was super nice.   She greeted us with a smile, and made us really feel welcome in here.   We settled for one of the specials, the grilled shrimp salad (I think that what it was) a portabella mushroom burger, a fresh catch sandwich and a regular burger.

All of our food was great, but the portabella burger was fantastic.  The food took a little bit too long to arrive, other than that no complaints.   Great restaurant to stop by when visiting Hilo.

name: Paul Campeau
text: So fun and tasty

name: Diana Karim
text: Great food and service. The food was delicious, but we were disappointed in the cost of one of the more expensive meals. It was ravioli with shrimp. There were 3 ravioli, and 3 shrimp, for $24. That seemed very overpriced. The pineapple drink, that came inside of a pineapple, was so good.

name: Kai Wang
text:
Coming into Hilo late that evening, we just wanted to find somewhere close to dine. And while my wife misread the ‘fresh’ to be ‘French’, and wondered half-way through the meal why any of this is ‘French’, there is a certain energy in the place carried by the servers that makes this spot pop.

We had some poke with salad, that was good for a late dinner. Kudos to our server though — super energetic for that time of the evening, it helped to lift the spirit on a particularly rainy night.

name: Drew Darcy
text: Great gluten free options from gluten free menu!  Food was excellent.  Fun atmosphere with open air dining.

name: Stephen Wilton
text: Great service...fast and food is fresh and good! Wait is never long...

name: Dayna Danes
text: We loved our lunch choices and drinks. Staff was amazing and fun.

name: Joshua Collier
text: Crazy long wait. The hostess told us we were next several times and then proceeded to seat several other parties. Food was so so. The drink that comes in a pineapple was amazing.

name: Brett Downes
text: Great experience. Seating was awesome being the Outdoor feel. Food was very tasty and reasonably priced. Service was very friendly and welcoming too!

name: Trish Champagne
text: In time of COVID, experience was positive.  Good food, safe social distancing, felt good to sit in a restaurant.

name: Johanna Garcia
text: Love the food !! I tried Poke for the first time and it was delicious! We grabbed some drinks during happy hours and they were good too.

name: Brianna Kilpatrick
text: Good food at decent prices. Drinks (alcoholic) are the specialty of this particular restaurant. Place to go if you want a good alcoholic beverage.

name: abigail fleishour
text: Love this place, fresh food, friendly staff and good prices

name: Helen He
text: Not the highest quality ingredients but unique and creative dishes

name: Ryan Morey
text: Great service. Full sized portions. I ordered the Local Special and took half home for lunch the next day. I would go back. Appetizers were delicious too.

name: Angie Grace
text: Great tasting food with awesome Customer Service

name: Cicely Simmons-Carroll
text: Great food, wonderful breezes, reasonably priced

name: Monica Guevara
text: Go here for the Great atmosphere, live music, and friendly staff. We had the pineapple pow (watch out for the pow), lychee margarita and mai tai. Food was OK, mostly tried the appetizers and the mushroom plate was the best.

name: jan stenko
text: If you do like the “microwave cuisin” you’re well welcome in this restaurant. The meals are not fresh at all. I have found the hair in my meal. It serves as the honor for this restaurant we havent paid after our complains.

name: Lisa King
text: Great service. Great food. Great vibe. On of my favs.

name: Whitney Aragaki
text: I appreciate that the staff is so friendly and welcoming. The server tonight was very polite and entertained us with his light-hearted humor. The staff allowed us to stay and relax well after the restaurant stopped serving food and drinks. We appreciated the atmosphere, especially as it was busy on the start of a long weekend.

name: Lowden Borgens
text: Good food and good atmosphere.

name: Mauro Bellati
text:
Got a poke on a rainy Tuesday evening. It was ok, nothing incredible though.
But the outdoor tables, the music and the staff are nice.
Considering the poor alternatives around Hilo, this is quite a gem.

name: Nancy Aldrich
text: We had a really good time and a wonderful meal. Stacy was our contact and she was perfect!

name: Pete Stachowicz
text: Five people max at the bar, even with food orders. Great service, though.

name: C LuvsBlue
text: Vegan friendly & the food is just AMAZING 😍

name: Elizabeth Dacus
text: unfriendly and not ok to have just enough money for one beer... not a local place .. unless you have LOTS of money... the musicians are terrific though... hope they are paid well....

name: Dylan T. R.
text: This place is great! Consequently I work here so pls come tip me

name: Ryan Divis
text: The Pineapple POW drink is amazing. We were here for lunch. The food was really good.

name: Debra Wolfe
text: Fun place to eat. They had a singer there for entertainment while we were there on a Thursday evening. I liked my curry chicken roll.

name: Aaron Box
text:
This place is fantastic. The ambience is perfect - quintessential small, beachside, exuberantly fun restaurant.

The seating is cozy but the dining area enjoys two open walls to let the breeze flow. The staff is very helpful, fun, and friendly.

The drinks are unique and delicious, particularly the signature one served inside a whole pineapple. Though it may seem touristy, it is whimsical and they execute it with local flair.

I will be back.

name: Diesel White
text: My wife and I truly had some of the most amazing food we've ever eaten. We ordered the purple sweet potato ravioli and the coconut encrusted catch of the day, which happened to be ono, and both were superb. They had such an fantastic depth of flavor that lingered on the tongue without being overpowering. It is all open aired, so it won't help you escape the heat, and is so popular that the noise levels make it less than intimate, but I would recommend everyone coming here and eating either, or both, of these two dishes.

name: Mick La Lopa
text: Excellent food and service and reasonable prices. They could cut the lighting in half though for better ambience.

name: Johnny C
text:
Food is delicious here.  Got the seared scallops, seafood pasta, fish and chips, hurricane shrimp,coconut crusted fresh fish, and the mai tai sampler.
Skip the Pineapple POW because there is no POW, you get a lot of sugar water inside a pineapple.  Expensive for not a lot of alcohol.

name: Kazuo Todd
text: The atmosphere is cool, the food is decent, the price is usually $30-$40 per person. While all the food is acceptable, there has been nothing I have eaten here to rave about. I really like the art on the walls, the live music, and the scenery, it almost makes up for the food being just food.

name: Aaron todd
text: Coolest lil restaurant ever! Their specialty Hawaiian mai tai comes in a whole maui golden pineapple,  muy excellente!

name: Tess Johnson
text: Amazing atmosphere and even better food!

name: Jill Coscarelli
text: We came here on a Friday night. There was a line for seating but we were seated within 10 minutes. There is a small bar on one side of this small restaurant. Waitress was very friendly and attentive. We ordered the chicken sandwich, the teriyaki flank steak and the Hilo local plate. The sandwich was average but good. The flank steak was tasty. The kalua pork was very good but the Kalbi ribs were very fatty. I picked at them but ultimately didn't eat much. We also had the Haupia dream dessert that was a slice of heaven: coconut cream goodness! Overall, the place was friendly, quick and good food.

name: Amy
text: Sweet potato ravioli with prawns in la crema, delicious.  Raviolis and prawns executed well.  Husband said top ten meal he has ever had.  Coconut crusted fresh fish was solid.  Cheese puffs were too garlicky.  Live music made it fun and upbeat.  Fruit punch drinks were pretty and tasted delightful.

name: hitch hikers guide to the galaxy
text: Yummy unique dishes with friendly occomadating staff!!!

name: Anna Laut
text: Hilo local plate and Poke tower very recommendable. Live music and excellent service!

name: Travis Sanders
text:
Superb flavors, big portions, was never left thirsty.  I'll tell you about the fish nachos, coconut crusted catch & unique Frozen...

Friday night 6:30 p.m. Live local music not too loud. They gave us a tall picture of Cold clean filtered water so we we're never given the opportunity to have food stuck in our throat wile hoping for a waitress to bring water.

Coconut crusted ahi was cooked nice and moist.
It was on top of mashed red potatoes heavy on the garlic but good especially with the fresh pineapple in the same bite.
It came with grilled onions peppers and squash that tasted great & fresh!

Fish Nachos were awesome smothered in quality cheese and the plate was so hot it kept my cheese melted throughout my meal.  The chips were surprisingly crispy even the ones smothered in beans at the bottom.  No surprise there was fresh pineapple in it !
Guacamole was 7 out of 10 which is better than most.

We got a sprite & large alcoholic hollowed out Frozen pineapple POW with with creamy drink inside. It was awesome especially when we stirred the cream in.   Reminded me a little of an Orange Julius.  The pineapple was so cold that fruit juice partially froze frothy on the sides. (Very refreshing) Other reviews said it was a strong drink so we had them water it down a bit and it was just right. It was big enough for two.  (We both had to drive) and as a bonus we get to bring the top of 2 pineapples home to plant and grow another.

We'll certainly be back again.  Total $65

name: Michael Chase
text: Great food and great service. The pork and ribs plate was really good and the fish sandwich is one of the best! Photo is from the artwork in the men's restroom

name: Barbara Devine
text: Good menu, good service really enjoyed ourselves

name: reena KC
text: The restaurant has a great vibe and location. In the heart of Hilo. Pretty busy, a popular spot. Staff super helpful and friendly. Ordered beet salad with goat cheese. Had a lot more arugula than beets in it, but this seems to be the standard in most restaurants. I have yet to find an actual beet salad in a restaurant haha! Burger was good but nothing out of the ordinary. Their white Pineapple cider was delicious.

name: Andrew Herman
text: Great lunch spot, food is tasty, staff is friendly, and service is quick. Got the Ono fish sandwich and it was excellent

name: Kyrie Burrus
text: Would have loved to go back today, but they were closed... best food we've had Hilo side all week... reasonable prices,  fantastic food choices,  fresh,  local... go there if you get the chance... live music was lovely too... also kid friendly... DELICIOUS!  Good service too.

name: Terry Curtis
text: Lots of delicious food, presented in a gorgeous way! So ono! We're coming back! Thanks, Jess!

name: Abigail Granner
text:
The reviews are accurate- this place is incredible! One block from the ocean, open air seating, and a fresh, inspiring menu. I got the classic pulled pork w/fresh pineapple and a tropical coleslaw, sweet potato fries on the side. Drink of choice: pineapple mojito—refreshing and not too sweet.

Great service too! Definitely recommend.

name: Kirsten Carlson
text: Nice location and very good meals.

name: Robert Kingsford
text: This was the most amazing meal we have eaten in the last 10 days in Hawaii. The food was great and the service was excellent! The swordfish & sweet potato chips and the coconut crusted Ahi were Amazing! The pineapple colada was sooooo good!

name: Gwen Gober
text: Great local flavor & atmosphere. Highly recommend.

name: Daniel Pino
text:
*Good bar/live music
*Food was not up to par (Buffalo wings, Fish Dynamite Bowl)

name: Heather Godsey
text: Great place to grab drinks and food with friends. The atmosphere is fun and the staff was super friendly.

name: Janis Meyer
text: Open air. Fish done just right. Friendly service.

name: Elaine Toth
text: Only open when the ships R in. Tourest orientated. Must B good though, cause they always have a full house! Check it out sometime

name: Jasmine Sasaki
text: The fried cheese balls are amazing!!! The food and drinks are great and the vibe is always lively with good music and service.

name: Ms Lady
text: Great food but a bit pricey

name: Jason Aston
text: I think pineapples has the best atmosphere in Hilo. The restaurant itself is covered, but it is open to the outside. The food is good and the prices are generally good. Most of the food has a pineapple aspect to it in one way or another. If that's what you like this is the place for you!

name: Tim Plimbim
text: Very cool music, the Lava Burger was fantastic. Nice pineapple ale. We loved it.

name: Sid S
text: The food was delish! Highly recommend. Sadly have to say the service was quite poor, hopefully was a one off. 3 servers cleaning the table next to us? Odd. And not one attentive enough?! next to impossible to get their attention and impossible to get a refill. Seem more interested in chitchat. None the less, the food was spot on, should check out but be aware.

name: Pamela Reynolds
text: Fantastic food as well as the service

name: Karen D
text: Fun, good food and drinks.  Excellent fish tacos!

name: Audra Ghiotto
text: Plenty of great food. Planning on going back. Thumbs up. The only thing I would have liked to change is the seating area...I felt like the people we were sitting next to were part of our 2 person party (uncomfortable to carry on private conversation). I want to add again that the food was great and I will go back.

name: Bruno Beaudoin
text: Fun and friendly restaurant with lots of choice and pretty good food.  Parking is hard to find around though, but there's free public parking in walking distance.

name: Eric Long
text: No air conditioning. Seating is limited and crammed. The menu is all over the place. We couldn't even get two glasses of water when we sat down. Then one had ice and another didn't? Seemed like she was pouring warm water.  Between that, the lack of service, and the crammed seating wasn't even worth trying the food. Very disappointed.

name: Greg Power
text: Nice open air atmosphere. The Ono stir special was delicious and the Mail Tai is good and strong

name: Theresa Guthrie
text: Good spot for happy hour 2-5pm (in bar area only!) with deals on drinks and pupus. Open air bar and restaurant, but covered.

name: Kali Crownover
text: My husband and I went here for drinks and dinner, it was delicious! Big portions and reasonably priced. My husband loved the pineapple pow and the pineapple mojito is refreshingly sweet. Excellent service, highly recommend!

name: Brian Locke
text: The Coconut Encrusted Catch of the Day was my favorite meal on the Big Island!

name: Kim Douglas
text: Try the Real Hawaiian Punch! Great Food Large Portions!

name: Cole Steven
text: Good food in a great location. They have daily specials and live music on Fri. Seems like lots of tourists were here but still gave off a very local vibe. Prices were fair and staff was adequate. Their house pineapple ale was not quiet as good as I had hoped and wasnt the coldest. Would definitely go again.

name: Courtney Trout
text:
Our server was friendly, outgoing and gave a great suggestion... the "Hilo Lunch Plate," pictured.  It was literally enough food for two people.  My husband had the chicken Caesar salad and it was enough for 2 people as well.  The dressing was super flavorful and felt like a fiesta to the taste buds.  I had an after lunch Mai Tai, it was absolutely stunning.  I highly recommend trying to find a spot in the bar, as their HH is from 2pm to 5pm during the week, and the drink difference is $5 on the Mai Tai's....
Would recommend this place to anyone who was visiting downtown South Hilo!!!..

name: Chris Alvarez
text: Wonderful food, and ambient live music.

name: Jonathan Donner
text: It was ok nothing to phone home about

name: Steven Mulari
text:
Great food and drink options.
I can recommend the portabello burger and a mai tai sampler (lilikoi is a must).

name: Danny Nicolino
text: Great food. Great drinks! One of the best places in Hilo.

name: Brian Buckley
text: Great service

name: Jennifer M.H.
text: Great atmosphere,  live music,  good food, friendly service.

name: Jerid Rathore
text: Breaded Mahi mahi with mashed potatoes and vegetables was delicious.  I wish we had that fish back in Winnipeg!!

name: Josh Howard
text: I would recommend this place to anyone traveling to the island. we went here for a friend's birthday had an amazing time, the food was absolutely on point and their drinks are creative and tasty as well. they also gave our friend a shot of moonshine on house for his birthday!

name: Markus Heid
text: We  been there twice within 3 days.  Vey friendly service and delicious food make it easy to come back. They have  live music ad well.  Great place!

name: James Willich
text: Excellent fare, bountiful drinks. Too big to eat the whole meal though

name: Faith Parry
text: Fabulous food! Great drinks! Stacy is wonderful! Love this place! Delicious fish!

name: jim hamilton
text: Fun drinks in a carved out pineapple.  Food & sevice both very good.

name: MIGUEL TENORIO
text: ONE OF THE BEST RESTAURANTS I EVER BEEN IN THE ENTIRE WORLD,

name: Lois L
text: Great food and staff. Only drawback was no shade .

name: Eric Swynenberg
text: If I was rating just the drinks and ambiance, it would be a solid 5 STARS. The staff was super awesome and friendly. They got our party of four in on a small top but then allowed us to combine two tables when the party next to is finished so we could spread out. They had a local artist performing who is really good. It is also open air which was refreshing which prevented the noise level from being over bearing. We had the Pineapple POW both with and without alcohol and both were AMAZING. The food was good but I thought it was a little overpriced which is why I only gave it 4 stars. The lettuce cups were ok, we all agreed that they would be better if we would have added chicken. They only one that didn't have a good time was my wallet!

name: Peter Lee
text: If u come Hilo, u must visit here n taste pineapple burger

name: Gregory Monkey
text: Happy hour is great and so is the food. Try the local plate if you want some of the best flavored pork loin and ribs, followed by leaving feeling like pork because the dish is so big.

name: James Tucker
text: Good food, everyone enjoyed their meal! Delighted

name: Matt Ricketts
text: We LOVED this place! And the pricing wasn't that bad either. We arrived a little late for lunch and was in the bar area long enough to when happy hour started. I can tell you we will return for happy hour. The sliders were large enough to be meal for two. We ordered the fish n chips and loco plate. Everything tasted incredible. The BBQ pork was our top favorite.

name: HisNHers Eternity
text:
Very pleasant,my beautiful daughter took me there for my first time...i loved it...it was a special mom n daughter night...my fiancee surprised me with an engagement ring, red napkin cloth holder ( his own) n ring in center n wrote on cloth  WILL U MARRY ME..I AM A BETTER PERSON BECAUSE OF YOU...GOD BLESSED ME WITH THE GREATEST GIFT...YOU...I CAN STARE AT UR BEAUTY ALL DAY...ETC, ..i cried!!!  SAID YES.Always remember that night....
......but a better location because of disrespectful drivers...people are breathing in bad toxic..n carbon monoxide.  EXCELLENT FOOD,N EXCELLENT CUSTOMER SERVICE! 6 STARS!

name: Jose DeSousa
text: Loved this place great food and drinks, along with live entertainment.

name: Ellen Train
text: Generous serving size. Tasty Nicose salad with two serving of fresh fish perfectly cooked. Good looking fish and chips. Well varied menu. Nice service staff.

name: Anthony Rayl
text: Huge portions, good food, reasonable prices, fun atmosphere. It's all outside, so might avoid when it is particularly hot outside.

name: Travis Hamill
text: The food was good, but just a tad overpriced - there are other restaurants in Hilo that are just as good and slightly more affordable, but the quality itself was very good.  Atmosphere is very nice, and the appetizers were very tasty (particularly the mushrooms).  Staff was attentive and friendly.

name: Joanne Leger
text: Great casual place for yummy food and drinks.  Open air but breezy so it never felt hot.

name: Jacqui McMahon
text: Excellent!  Twinkles the bartender. .gave great service!

name: Jamie Goh
text: Make this the very first restaurant you go to in Hilo!! The catch of the day is so fresh and taste wonderful! Definitely one of the best restaurants in town.

name: Robert Bauer
text:
First time here. Great service. Solid pupus
My entree, Ona as fish of the day, was tremendous.

name: Teri Wolff
text: Super fun place to stop by.. all the drinks are delicious and the staff is friendly and attentive. Highly recommend if you venture to this side of the island .

name: Verna Badua
text: Great service and delicious food, I'd go again

name: Ann Maria Thomas
text:
One of the best restaurant in Hawaii catering local food.
- Food : was very delicious and yummy.  Pineapple Pina colada is really top notch. Entrees, had mouthwatering fish dish.
- Ambience : very good Ambience. Live music was playing all the time. Open air dining area also available.  Place is crowded.
- Services - very good, friendly and lovely services. They clearly clarified our doubts on some Ingredients.
-Price : costly. A bit overpriced, but worth a visit.

name: lance & bianca yamamoto
text: Nice place, great location, open atmosphere.

name: William McMurray
text: Largest and best calamari appetizer in the world, a must order!

name: Randall Hayes
text: It is the only open air eatery in hilo! Music, awesome help, nice atmosphere with prices that won't peel your eyes back! I must say go and do this!! If you don't who's the pineapple! Awesome open air vibes! Aloha!

name: Shane Hiro
text: Great food and staff, good prices, great atmosphere

name: Charity Schwartz
text: Bit of an odd Location. Open air seating on a very busy street corner. The food was great though. Love the coconut crusted fish and the pork had amazing flavor.

name: Stella Gerstberger
text: Our food was delivered cold and the food does not taste good. Miso soup is not really miso soup and the fries was very cold and greasey.

name: Alexandria Killian
text: Open later than most places in Hilo and the food is amazing!!!

name: michael gouch
text: Pineapple drinks were delicious and scallops were yummy along with salad.

name: Joshua Maness
text: Always great food and Atmosphere

name: Dan Moisa
text: It looks like the only restaurant in town. Great service, very nice while you wait, which you have to do if you don't reserve or go there early. Portions are huge but you'll eat everything because it's fresh, tasty, well cooked and with lots of variety. Great atmosphere, especially with the live entertainment.

name: Albert Yanez
text: Good food great drinks and the service excellent

name: Bill Eichenlaub
text: Very slow, ordered them saw there others come in, order and get served before out food came. The for was excellent when it finally got there.

name: Gerry Baldwin
text: As a B-747 captain, I've eaten at the finest restaurants world wide. Pineapples ranks among the best. Not only will you find great food, service, and drinks, but the open air seating is perfect for Hawaii's weather. It is not just a great place to eat but a dining experience. Telephone for reservations, as Pineapples is in high demand.

name: Joseph Gelfand
text: Lively and tasty restaurant in Hilo.  The pulled pork and short ribs are especially tasty.  Reservations recommended due to long lines.

name: Alicia Moore
text: The staff are super friendly and accommodating!  Our waiter was Blake he was amazing!

name: Colby Jenson
text: Excellent service, open to the excellent weather, and delicious food.

name: John Juliano
text:
Pineapples is a very Hilo place. The staff is a mix of Hilo Natives and new arrivals and all quite genuine and very nice.

Happy hour is a wonderful time to go there for half-price Mai Tais. A word on the Mai tais, they are delicious and two shot drinks, so they are quite deadly. You have been warned. There are also happy hour hors d'oeuvres.

We haven't eaten dinner there, instead going to be very popular and local Lucy's Taqueria.

name: lynn Leach
text: A delightful outdoor restaurant with good food, friendly staff, pleasant Hawaiian music in the background. Very casual family friendly

name: Jarrod Eden Smith
text: Not a wallet killer per se. Decent drinks.menu is so so, but location lends to fun people watching.

name: Mary
text: All of people is nice. But I saw cockroaches on my table.  Because I was very disgusting. I want to avoid here.

name: Jamie Jorgensen
text: Great food & Service. Didn't try the Pineapple Pow but it looked amazing. Lots of people were ordering it.

name: garret wykowski
text: Good food nice people

name: Fred Watkins
text: Great food, reasonable prices, we arrived right at the dinner hour on Friday night, had a short wait, were seated, ordered and they served us quickly. Barbara was a great waitress, the food was hot and delicious.

name: Yeshaya Amichai
text: Best happy hour in Hilo! Hands down. Prices for the quality of food on the happy hour menu can't be beat.

name: marcus
text: Had such an amazing dinner here with the family!

name: JV Smith
text: Excellent food and service, plus generous portions! Will definitely eat here again....and again!!

name: Eaton Companies LLC.
text: Didn’t get to eat here. Looked good but didn’t want to wait an hour and a half so we went elsewhere.

name: Erin Bossons
text: Great food and delicious alcoholic drink in a pineapple felt very tropical!

name: A Gator
text:
Mixed experience:
The BAD -  the "seafood" dish meat consists primarily of what I am certain was CHICKEN breast with scarcely any clam, oyster, shrimp or scallop.
The GOOD - on a quite holiday night with most places closed they were a lively restaurant with staff tired but still working very hard to have a friendly and lively experience.

name: Dean Itagaki
text: Good food, good service, good atmosphere!

name: Virginia Terry
text: Yummy open air restaurant, so glad we found it during our stay!

name: BloNdeChiNeEz
text:
Cannot say enough good things about Pineapples!
Fantastic fresh Pacific rim food at its best!
Can be pricey if you order several pupus, drinks a couple of entrees and of course desserts cause it's all crazy onoliscious!

name: Sheng Yang
text: Ordered Pineapple Pow, Hilo Local Plate and Pineapple Burger. Pineapple Pow looks interesting but the taste is just ok. Hilo local plate is on the fatty side, especially for the short ribs. I enjoyed my pineapple burger, but mostly for the beef. IMO, it's a nice place to have meal if it's along your route.

name: Bronx bulldog
text: Ate there twice food was excellent one of the better places to eat.

name: Dallin Kimble
text: I really like the idea of this place. It's an open-air restaurant with a great selection of food that gives it a good vibe. On this occasion however, I feel like it stumbled. The service was really, really slow both seating us and bringing out our food. My Island Tacos were 90% cabbage with very little meat or other flavors. My wife said her burger was good. I expect it is probably better than my experience most of the time, but all things considered it was really just okay overall.

name: Ed Faza
text: Really good fresh dishes. Reasonable prices

name: Liz Montrey
text: Don't like 'em.  Bad attitudes prevail.  Not EVERYONE is rich & famous.  Even ha'oles.  This is HILO.. Get a grip...

name: Robin G
text: Lauren gave us superior service, even with a full house. The fish and chips were among the best I've ever had. Definitely go for the sweet potato fries.

name: Deborah Safarik
text: Fast service for lunch

name: aashish takkala
text: The dynamite fish bowl is a must try!

name: Katelynd Mahoney
text: The best in Hilo! Was taken here by some locals who swear by it.  No other place to eat! The margarita flight is terrific. The staff is even better! The pineapple burger is amazing, and enough food to feed more than one! Cannot wait to come back.

name: WH B
text: Our server Ohu was excellent.  Pam, the owner was very warm, friendly and informative.  There were so many drink and food choices.  We will have to go back and try some more.

name: Rob-Bob Ceglinski
text: Great food, fun atmosphere, nice bar, great service. When we were there, there was also a nice, live musician. We heard a recommendation on Kauai from someone on a cruise that had been to Hilo a couple days before. Proved a worthwhile tip!

name: Jeffrey Suckow
text: Try the lava burger.  Very tasty for those who don't mind a touch of heat.

name: Douglas Terhune
text: Great drinks and their fish and chips are tasty.  Their Korean ribs were good.....  I almost couldn't eat it all the portion was so large.  Order a Mai Tai with your meal.

name: Eduard Mihalascu
text: Awesome food and drinks, very good service. Very much recommend it.

name: Jill Burrows
text: Great ambience, open air seating, live music with guitarist. Had the French Onion Soup, Furikake battered shrimp and a Mai Tai with lilikoi added- delicious! A little wait to get in (a good sign), but had a drink, listened to music and watched the people go by while waiting! Friendly staff. Got a coconut dessert to go that was enjoyed later at Onekahakaha beach.Would recommend!

name: Alex Griffin
text: A Hilo staple. Food and drinks are wonderful, a lunch of hurricane shrimp and one of their POW drinks is sublime. Gets pretty crowded with tourists, especially if there's a cruise ship docked. Surfing usually on TV and a full bar.

name: Michael Vogel
text: Nice little restaurant with a good selection foods and friendly staff.

name: Joyce Kucyn
text: Fun people, good HI local food

name: Sean Anderson
text: It was pretty good, but not excellent. I don't have enough experience with restaurants in Hilo to say this was better than others. But, I've heard some great things about this place that did not really pan out. My meal was actually pretty good. I had the coconut/panko catch of the day, with chicken wings appetizer. The wings were fantastic! My friend had a vegetarian dish that was less than spectacular.. All in all, if you are a tourist here, it's not a bad place..

name: Ashley W
text: Delicious food and great staff and strong drinks!

name: John Tao
text:
Happy hour for the win!

Fish tacos and beers! Go for happy hour, delicious mai tais, cheap beer and amazing fish tacos.

name: Len Quadracci
text: Great service.  Every plate is special.

name: Arizona Dave
text: Fun place to eat and enjoy ocean views

name: Paul Norman
text: Good food, good music, good company. That's really all I need.

name: Michael Amato
text: Great service,  good stuff

name: J R Lazar
text: Food was excellent.  Staff a bit over-caffeineted but very friendly.  Enjoyed very much.

name: Alicia H
text: A little in the pricey side but the portion size you get is large! The food was very good. Our waiter was so nice and the atmosphere was great.

name: Nikhil Verma
text:
The service was excellent. We were waiting for a table to become available and hung near the entrance and the bar. I was worried that they make not take our orders at the bar given where we were seated but to my surprise, they not only took our orders but were very accommodating during the process.
The food was excellent. We had the nui nachos, the local plate and a couple of drinks.

name: James R Chapman 4
text: Great service,,, Great food

name: William Groom III
text: Great food and service we had pork sandwich with sweet potato fries and local brew was wonderful

name: Steve Sampson
text: Nice place in a quaint little city environment.  Very good food and super friendly service.

name: Sean Janeway
text: Really good food. Great location. Good atmosphere. Sometimes (always?) live music. The only downside is that it's a little spendy but not horrendously so. I regularly recommend this place to others.

name: Sanjay Shah
text: Ok good.  Good atmosphere.

name: Lindsey Cote
text: One of my favorite places to eat in Hilo! Upscale food in a relaxed, open air environment. The staff was amazing and the menu had so many options. From seafood to burgers and salads...it was all delicious. Great prices for such fresh, high quality ingredients. I loved the live music too!

name: Lan Au
text: Enjoyed happy hour...pupus good, wait help cordial

name: ed shaffer
text: Good food and atmosphere,  bad service.  Ordered off their specials menu,  wait staff brought out a different version of what I ordered. When I told the waitress the item was incorrect she said that it was correct. I then pointed. To the special menu on the chalkboard where it describes what my order contained. She then took the order from me and 5 minutes later came back with the original incorrect order with additional items piled on top.  Bottom line she should have just corrected the order without lying to me about it.

name: al scullin
text: Good food. Neat location in old Downtown Hilo. Barbera was an excellent server.

name: T Sea
text: Great menu. I was skeptical but was totally surprised.

name: Carlos Gonzalez
text: Good service and really good food.

name: Michael Pittmon
text: Great food!  Quality and very tasty!

name: Paul Ang
text: Best happy hour in town.

name: Dennis Derecho
text: Great place for drinks and hors d'oeuvres! We stopped in at Pineapples on a Sunday. One of the only places that was open. Good food, good drinks friendly and helpful staff. We will be back on any return visits

name: Paul Susmarski
text: Wonderfully delicious fresh fish and a few other delicious looking options. The pineapple pow is a great cocktail that is worth stopping for and sharing. The service staff is super friendly and great.

name: Grigor Fedan
text: Good noveau cousine at reasonable prices. Some vegetarian fare. Very good sweet potato fries...fish sandwich, chicken wrap...and great desserts.

name: leobardo viveros
text: Good food and price little high ok

name: Vivi Vu
text: #eatoutside #vegetarianfriendly #healthy great customer service. Our waiter Nick was amazing. Ordered specialty drink.. and we didn't even realize when it came out it was leaking. He noticed right away and took it away and gave us a new one. Food was so good and very generous portions.

name: Wesley Newberry
text: Good service, nice happy hour prices.

name: Clayton Conway
text: Gotta get a drink in a pineapple while you're here.  The food and service was actually very good and the atmosphere is great.

name: Colorado Reed
text: Kind of a standard tourist bar, but they had a decent happy hour and open air seating

name: Seth Grasse
text:
Wonderful poke. "Pineapple Pow" was delicious and good for sharing.

Second time: Fish was well presented but didn't taste fresh.

name: brian smith
text: I was surprised by how good this place was. Menu is large and plenty of options. If you have allergies they can accommodate. Way to find location and a really cool atmosphere.

name: David Corona
text: Place is crowded. There is a long wait to get your food. No place to park. Its overpriced.

name: Leslie Barton
text: Fabulous Food, Presentation, and Service!!! Bright and Lively with Friendly Vibes!! PINEAPPLES IS PONO!

name: Michael Graff
text: Good food. Fair prices. Nice open air setting.  Our food came faster than one would think possible.

name: Jacky
text:
More like diner food here. Ordered their pineapple burger and it was just a regular burger with a slice of pineapple. I guess i had higher expectations.

Toppings on nachos were just slathered on. so the middle to bottom had nothing.

Bathroom available. Street parking free for an hour. (not sure how often ticket cops come by..) More than enough time to eat.

name: Greg Mccreight
text: Awesome atmosphere,great food and drinks #1!

name: Audrey Stuckey
text: Delicious food! Loved the open-air atmosphere!

name: macdaknife100
text: Great food and excellent service

name: Lynne Argento
text: Great food, delicious food, big portions!

name: tom puglisi
text: Great food and service.. ✌️

name: Ben C
text: Great little oasis in the weird world of hilo. Great drink specials for happy hour, gotta try their local beers, a great selection for the location. Very friendly staff that makes you feel welcome and keep the drinks flowing!

name: Karen Haberly
text: Really delicious food! Pleasant outdoor tables, fun drinks. I can't say enough about how good the Hawaiian plate and the burgers were. Go!

name: Kevin Dunn
text: Had fun and good food.

name: Rich Struhm
text: Pineapples is a very cool old Hawaiian style restaurant. Located in an old open air building that once was a flower exchange. The atmosphere is great and the food is great

name: Shelly Green
text: Went for happy hour...no seats available only outside....no problem. Except they don't serve drinks outside...agreed to take seating anyways, then they forgot we were out there😞.

name: Marcus Mack
text: Very good food and the selection is good as well. A different vibe while eating here. Feels like a foreign country. I recommend trying it out.

name: Crissa Okamura
text: Very good food, always clean & fresh. Seating is very open & airy, parking is a little difficult. Drinks are very yummy also, they have quite a bit of unique adult drinks available. A bit pricey & reservations do help. The bar has sports tv.

name: Jessica Dixon
text: 2 words. GO HERE. We happily ate our weight in delicious food and drinks on our last night on the island. They have pineapple drink cored out and filled with alcohol and even though we didnt get it, it looked awesome. I am gluten free and got the macadamia nut chicken with garlic mashed potatoes and I ate the whole thing. It was big enough to share but I ate it myself 😁. My husband got a special and also ate it all. It's an open air style restaurant so you dont need to get dressed up. Wish we would have gone sooner on our trip we would have gone back!

name: Mike G
text: Great place in Old Hilo town.  Multiple island beers on tap.  Enjoyable guitarist that entertains but not so loud you can't enjoy conversation with friends   Great island food.  Worth a visit.

name: Susan Marinucci
text: Fun place, great surf & turf!

name: David Ring
text: Night Staff make this place great. Reminded me of my service industry days. Food was great, wasn't to impressed with the happy hour nachos but what can you expect, they were $3.

name: gregory crum
text: Awesome service!  Thanks Renee!  Music and atmosphere were just right.  Highly recommended!

name: Kaity Kat
text: Love the outside setting. They always seem to have live entertainment. Very festive during the holidays and welcoming staff.

name: Gonzzo 55
text:
Great location, amazing staff!....
Food is a bit eccentric(?), But we'll put together!, All the flavor combinations deliver a unique bite, every time.
Stop by, I recommend it!.

name: Shruthi Sreenivas
text: Good service, lot of drink choices, food was okay. Pork was salty and overcooked in the Kalua pork tacos.

name: chris b
text: Ok food service was good, atmosphere was nice

name: Ryan Freedman

I guess they make good cocktails though.

text: Loved this place. We lucked out and got seated right away on a Sunday night. We opted for the spring roll app and I ordered the portobello sandwich. Best bella sandwich I’ve had...and I’ve had a lot. Service was fast and friendly. No kids menu, but the server offered several kid-friendly dishes that the kitchen would whip together on request. My daughter got to customize her request, felt like she was special and gobbled it up. Everything, including drinks, tasted fresh and local and the looks of everything coming out of the kitchen made me decide I need to go back. Don’t miss this place.

Went here for a late lunch because it was recommended by a local and has  great reviews.  I am not sure if my expectations were set to high but I found this restaurant to be much like a Hawaiian style Apple Bee’s. It has a open air dinning room which added to the tropical feel long with the smell of fresh pineapple.
The menu has some local type dishes however nothing really special.  I ordered the Kalbi Beef Ribs they were okay. My husband had a Cheese burger which was very good. We had happy hour drinks but the Mai Tai was on the list but when our bill can only the beers where happy hour priced and the Mai Tai was $10 not the $5 that was advertised in the chalkboard. Summing up my visit to Pineapple’s—The food was average selection but tasty and the service was good (was just what had out for the happy hour pricing).

Meh, these guys have a lot of problems. I've never had consistent service. Some days I get helped right away and others, like my last visit, I sat for 45 minutes with the waiter constantly making eye contact with me but choosing to walk by me each time while I was waiting to give my DRINK ORDER!

On to the food. I know they have changed management a few times and fired their chef a few times but I have only had one good meal here out of the 7 or so I've had in the past few years. The other meals I've had: Undercooked meat, soggy fries, melted ice cream dessert, cold entrees, etc. I believe the kitchen works faster than the servers so my food sits and sits like I sit and sit.

Just avoid these guys, go to Pesto or Hilo Bay Cafe. I ONLY GIVE TWO STARS BECAUSE I HAD 1/7 GOOD MEALS HERE.

name: Ankit Patel
text:
Closer than ‘Akaka Falls, this scenic waterfall is just a few miles up the Wailuku river, which empties into Hilo Bay.

Rainbow Falls is altogether different, but no less appealing, dropping 24-metres over a lava cave. Where ‘Akaka Falls has a single, narrow jet, Rainbow Falls is almost 30 metres across and thunders into a large pool.

The time to come is early in the day, when a rainbow is created by the sun catching the waterfall’s mist. Also try to be here after a period of heavy rain, when the mist is thicker.

The trail to the top of the falls is well worth walking, guiding you past some huge banyan trees, including some centuries old and almost encased by fig vines.

The public trails are small, mainly focused on the view of the falls. Parking might be limited. There is a public restroom with wheelchair access.

The area is one of a kind. If your visiting Hilo, Hi., this is a must-see!

Several trails are available near Rainbow falls. If you visit and find the need to discover more areas to visit, open Google maps and search for waterfalls. You will discover a few in the area with public access.

For those of you seeking to swim, there is not much available regarding public access. However, locals know trails. Go talk to a local to get advice but be warned, your taking risks. Make sure to ask about those risks to be aware before you take a back trail off public access. Some risks include narrow and uneven trails, slippery, flash flooding, and potential drowning due to current under toes. Be smart and be careful!

text: Beautiful. Small parking lot so you may have to wait for parking but the wait usually is not long. There is a public restroom here but no soap in the restrooms. Go in the morning on a sunny day. Better chance of seeing the rainbows!

name: Syeda
text: Rainbow falls is absolutely gorgeous! It’s not too far from Hilo and you don’t have to hike or anything to see it. Great place to take pictures and you can walk up the stairs to the stop to get an even better view. There’s always people nearby selling coconut drinks! Definitely worth visiting.

name: JETS
text: Beautiful, easily accessible waterfall without any hiking. Nice views and restrooms on site. Parking can be an issue but just wait for a parking spot or park up the road.

name: Emily Gilreath
text: Beautiful waterfall, you don’t even have to hike to it which is a plus if you have people with you that are unable to hike. But if you want to hike, there are also trails right next to the falls.

name: Bryan Cunningham
text: Super easy to access (you walk like 20 feet from the parking lot) and quite beautiful. The little 100 foot hike up the stairs is worthwhile to see the trees beyond.

name: Monica Guevara

name: Jordan Offutt

I like to visit Rainbow Falls after a big rainstorm.

It cascades over a lava cave that according to legends is home to the ancient Hawaiian goddess Hina, the goddess of the moon.

The are trails to walk. And, lots of flowering shrubs and trees.

name: Anthony Turgman
text:
These falls are definitely easy to visit and provide am extremely short and worthwhile trek up to the top. Parking is free and I don't recall seeing a bathroom, so be aware. You can continue on beyond the water fall if you want to on a short trek to see some unique trees and an awesome canopy. You can also choose to go on the overlook side and stand across from the falls to view them head on.

At the top of the trail there are signs that indicate you cannot go past a certain point, but I believe they're there to keep you off the cliff side. Just be cautious when venturing past the paved area as there are a lot of roots on the ground and can be slippery when it's raining - as it was when we visited.

Unfortunately, there were no rainbows as it was incredibly overcast and rainy when we were there, but it was still worth the trip.
